The '''Luduria system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument known as the [[Ludurian nose flute]].<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ludurian nose flute]]|system=Luduria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Luduria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
